extension.news: v2.3.0 - Remove the unused Inter font set and its 10 MB of font files; the Default (Netflix Sans) and Arial font sets remain v2.2.1 - Fix empty Home menu after a skin update: rebuild menus when the main menu has no items v2.2.0 - Remove Live TV, music, pictures, games and weather; Kodi's built-in windows for them are now small placeholders that return Home - Remove the Live TV and Music hubs, the Live TV and Square views, and the Music menu group - Remove the LibreELEC/OpenELEC settings-screen copies and unused timer/record dialogs - Remove spotlight auto-trailers and the trailer settings v2.1.0 - Build menus once per boot instead of on every return to Home - Only save skin settings on Home load when a value changes - Keep only the Bingie Poster, Seasons, Episodes and List views (plus Live TV and Square until they are removed) - Turn off TMDb Helper Live TV lookups - Remove the info-screen Trailer button and unused auto-trailer code - Fix the invalid new-episode tag include in search results
